decisions.reason: The badge count and row layout do not change NFT-detail book-cover rendering; the NFT-sizing clause is separate runtime evidence and must not be propagated as a MODIFY.
Changing the displayed badge set to 19 badges in an 8/11 layout does not alter referral-milestone thresholds, on-chain attachment, or badge-award rules.
The source decision applies to the dashboard badge rows, not landing-page content or layout.
The badge-row arrangement does not affect landing-page book-cover placement, cropping, or size.
The badge presentation change does not alter referral eligibility or self-referral validation; the invalid-code clause is a separate topic in the multi-topic source message.
The dashboard badge count and row layout do not require any change to the About-page content.
Badge presentation does not change email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
The badge layout decision does not change FAQ content; the invalid-code wording is an independent clause and is already represented in the candidate state.
Changing badge count and dashboard row placement does not alter referral-code source, persistence, or display locations.
The badge presentation decision has no necessary effect on transactional-email delivery or email contents.
The dashboard badge-row layout does not affect ebook reader navigation, entry points, or view width.
The source changes the presented badge set and dashboard row arrangement, not whether permanent badges or referral data appear in NFT metadata.
